blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Young filmmakers from Mimaropa turned the struggles, aspirations, and resilience of agrarian reform beneficiaries into cinematic stories, with two films emerging as best films in the second year of the Department of Agrarian Reform’s PelikulAgraryo festival. The 13 entries from 10 production teams representing eight schools across the Mimaropa region were screened and judged before the winners were announced on Sept. 29, according to the DAR regional office in Mimaropa. Seven films competed in the Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries (ARB) category, while six competed in the Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries Organizations (ARBO) category. READ: MMFF announces return of […]...
